BLOCKED.label: BLOCKED
BLOCKED.headline: BLOCKED: Absolute Safety Interlock Triggered
BLOCKED.summary: A deterministic clinical safety rule blocked this proposal. One or more active medications, severe contraindications, or dose tripwires prohibit requested orders. Under safety rule R11, absolute BLOCK interlocks cannot be overridden.
actions: Review contraindicated medication and select alternative protocol therapy
Consult senior clinical staff or full reference guideline
Rule R11: Overrides are strictly prohibited for BLOCK verdicts

UNVERIFIED.label: UNVERIFIED
UNVERIFIED.headline: UNVERIFIED: Insufficient or Unresolved Clinical Data
UNVERIFIED.summary: The system could not establish a verified clinical plan. Essential physiological parameters, medication history, or protocol evidence were missing or below retrieval thresholds. Under fail-closed safety rule R2, no unverified orders can proceed.
actions: Provide missing patient vitals, weight, or history to enable unverified checks
Explicitly select or confirm suspected clinical syndrome
Re-run triage verification after data entry

CHECKED_ALERTS.label: CHECKED_ALERTS
CHECKED_ALERTS.headline: CHECKED WITH ALERTS: Clinical Warnings Require Review
CHECKED_ALERTS.summary: Deterministic safety checks were completed and identified non-blocking warnings (such as duplicate therapies, moderate interactions, or elevated scores). Clinician review and logged override justifications are required before proceeding.
actions: Review non-blocking alerts and drug interactions
Enter logged clinician override with rationale if proceeding with HIGH warnings
Administer verified steps with continuous monitoring

CHECKED_CLEAR.label: CHECKED_CLEAR
CHECKED_CLEAR.headline: CHECKED CLEAR: No Configured Safety Rules Triggered
CHECKED_CLEAR.summary: All applicable deterministic rules in the active ruleset fired clear without triggering alerts. Disclaimer: This confirms compliance with configured prototype rules, not absolute clinical safety.
actions: Review verified protocol steps with senior clinical staff
Confirm patient identification and presentation consistency
Re-assess vitals according to protocol observation schedule
